name: Architecture RFC & Decision Records
description: Standard operating procedure for drafting comprehensive technical design docs (TDD) and architecture decision records (ADR).
sopSummary: Enforces strict section hierarchy: Executive Summary, System Architecture, SQL DDL Schema, API Specifications, and Rollout Strategy.
instructions: Follow the RFC template: 1. Executive Summary, 2. High-Level Mermaid Architecture, 3. Relational/Vector Schema, 4. REST & SSE Contract, 5. Step-by-Step Implementation.

name: Deep Web Synthesis & Citation Grounding
description: Structured research playbook that queries search engines, evaluates source authority, and synthesizes cited answers.
sopSummary: Formulate multi-angle search queries, extract primary domain sources, filter commercial noise, and append numbered markdown footnotes.
instructions: Execute web search queries, verify 2+ sources, synthesize findings, cite domain URLs.

name: Obsidian Vault Note Ingestion & Linking
description: Playbook for writing bi-directionally linked Markdown files with frontmatter tags and Obsidian YAML metadata.
sopSummary: Structures frontmatter YAML (created, tags, aliases), uses [[WikiLinks]] for cross-note referencing, and writes atomic notes.
instructions: Format YAML frontmatter with date and tags, write concise markdown, link related topics.

name: AST-Verified Code Patching & Refactoring
description: Strict code modification playbook that checks Abstract Syntax Trees (AST) before applying file diffs.
sopSummary: Generates minimal unified diffs, runs AST parsing to prevent syntax breakage, and verifies unit test passing.
instructions: Inspect original code, generate atomic diff, run syntax check, format output cleanly.

name: CVE & Security Threat Model Review
description: Standard protocol for auditing authentication boundaries, SQL injection risks, and secret leakage.
sopSummary: Applies STRIDE threat modeling methodology, checks for hardcoded tokens, and verifies SQL parameterization.
instructions: Audit code for unsanitized inputs, check CORS and auth boundaries, document mitigations.

name: Calendar & Agenda Intelligent Dispatch
description: Procedural standard for parsing conversational meeting requests, resolving timezones, and creating calendar events.
sopSummary: Resolves relative dates (tomorrow, next Monday), validates duration against free slots, and populates attendee metadata.
instructions: Extract event title, date, time, and attendees, verify slot availability, create calendar event.
